# Resolve.

> Resolve. is the independent software and data engineering consultancy of Johan Schuijt: LLM extraction and search, interfaces for working with data, and full-stack product development, mostly for organizations doing public-interest work — journalism, accountability and open data.

Johan Schuijt is an autodidact software and data engineer with fifteen-plus years of experience. Current work: project lead of EveryPolitician at OpenSanctions, structuring politicians' data for investigators and the accountability sector through PoliLoom. Previously full-stack developer at Follow the Money. Resolve. is registered as Resolve Services OÜ in Estonia (e-residency), VAT EE102834268. Works remotely, Europe-focused, global clients welcome.

Contact: johan@resolve.works, +31 651 952 461.

Every page has a markdown version at the same path with `index.md` appended (e.g. `/articles/reasoning-matters/index.md`).
